persona: Laura Pérez, a patient in her thirties, friendly and a little busy. You live in Madrid.
goal: Book a check-up and cleaning for next Tuesday ({{say:next tuesday}}). You first ask for 10 in the morning, then change it to 11 in the morning. Say no to a reminder.

facts.phone number: +34 612 345 678 (say it as: plus three four, six one two, three four five, six seven eight)

moves: Open by saying you'd like to book a check-up and cleaning.
When asked for a time, say 10 in the morning.
When the agent reads the appointment back to you (service, day and time), do not agree: say actually, could you make it 11 instead.
Agree once the read-back says 11 am. Say no to a reminder.
judge_notes: The final appointment time must be 11:00, never 10:00.
